capabilities: Write time-credited activity rows from shorthand entries
Calculate end times, durations and split credit
Keep per-day project totals and period summaries
Report totals, group shares, streaks and best days
Correct, shift and combine logged rows
extras: Desktop only, with Windows as the tested platform. Further documentation lives in an external user guide. Cache and recovery files in the plugin folder store note text unencrypted.
problem: Planning a day and knowing where its time actually went usually needs a separate time-tracking app or spreadsheet instead of the notes themselves.

relations.evidence: moving from the old plain-planner ID

summary: Daily planner that turns shorthand entries into time-credited activity rows in plain Markdown daily notes and reports totals and records.
